cookieAuth.warning: Cookies give Downlodr the same access to a site as being signed in. Don't use an account you'd mind losing — sites do ban accounts for automated downloading.
cookieAuth.liveDesc: Downlodr reads cookies from your browser each time you download, so they never go out of date. You must be signed in to the site in that browser. Works while the browser stays open.
cookieAuth.importDesc: Chrome and Edge lock their cookie file while running, so Downlodr has to import a copy. Sign in first, fully close the browser, then click Import — you can reopen it afterward and leave it open. The copy does not update itself: when downloads start failing with sign-in errors, close the browser and click Re-import.
cookieAuth.loginDesc: Opens a browser window inside Downlodr so you can sign in without touching your own browser. Works for most sites, but not Google/YouTube — Google sign-in does not work in embedded windows for any app, including this one, so Firefox or Brave cookies remain the way to authenticate YouTube.
cookieAuth.siteLoginUrlPlaceholder: Paste a site URL, e.g. https://x.com/login
cookieAuth.fileDesc: Point Downlodr at a cookies.txt file exported from your browser.
cookieAuth.savedWithBrowser: Downlodr will use {{browser}} cookies for downloads
cookieAuth.savedFile: Downlodr will use your imported cookies file for downloads
cookieAuth.fileNotImportedWarning: You selected this option but haven't imported a file yet — cookie authentication will not work until you choose a file.
